chapterTitle: Chapter 4: He, She, It (Replacing Naming Words) 👦👧🎈
learningGoals: Understand that some short words can take the place of names to make speaking easier. 🗣️
Learn to use 'He' when talking about a boy, man, or male character. 👨
Learn to use 'She' when talking about a girl, woman, or female character. 👩
Learn to use 'It' when pointing out an animal, a place, or a thing. 🐶🚗
keyVocabulary: Pronoun - A friendly shortcut word that takes the place of a naming word. 🔄
Replace - To put a new word in place of a name. ✨
He - The word we use for boys, men, or grandpas! 👦
She - The word we use for girls, women, or grandmas! 👧
It - The word we use for animals, toys, and things! 🧸
Naming Word - The actual name of a person, place, animal, or thing (Noun). 🏷️
Boy - A male child (we use the pronoun 'He'). 🧢
Girl - A female child (we use the pronoun 'She'). 🎀
Animal - A living creature like a cat or bird (we use the pronoun 'It'). 🐾
Thing - An object like a ball or a pencil (we use the pronoun 'It'). ⚽
teachingTips: Be a Storytime Detective: While reading bedtime stories, pause and ask, 'The book says the princess is happy. Should we use He or She for the princess?' 📖
Family Photo Fun: Look at family pictures together. Point to Grandpa and say, 'He is smiling.' Point to Auntie and say, 'She is wearing red.' 🖼️
The Pet & Toy Rule: When playing with a pet or a favorite toy, emphasize 'It'. For example, 'Look at the ball! It is bouncing so high!' 🎾

Oops, Silly Mistakes!: Make intentional, funny mistakes to let your child correct you. Point to Dad and say, 'She is reading a book.' Wait for your little one to giggle and say, 'No, HE is reading!' 😂

funActivities.title: Pronoun Sorting Baskets 🧺
funActivities.description: Label three small baskets or bowls with 'He', 'She', and 'It'. Give your child a mix of small toys (action figures, dolls, animal figures, blocks) and have them drop each toy into the correct basket based on what pronoun it gets! 🧸

funActivities.title: The Pointing Game 👆
funActivities.description: Walk around the house and take turns pointing to family members or objects. If they point to Mom, they shout 'She!'. If they point to a chair, they shout 'It!'. Keep it fast, moving, and silly! 🏃‍♂️

funActivities.title: Puppet Show Replacements 🎭
funActivities.description: Use two hand puppets (a boy and a girl) and a prop (like an apple). Tell a short story using their names, then retell the exact same story replacing their names with 'He', 'She', and 'It'. Let your child try next! 🍎
